title: Fifth Brother Inquisitor
description: The Fifth Brother was an imposing member of the Imperial Inquisitorius who served the Empire and the Dark Lords of the Sith throughout much of the Empire's reign. Tight-lipped and brutal, he used his double-bladed Lightsaber to hunt rebels with delight, as well as Jedi like Kanan Jarrus, Ezra Bridger, Ahsoka Tano, and even Obi-Wan Kenobi over the years.
